name: light-remote
description: Governed remote computing for AI agents across user-owned devices with local policy, durable sessions, real terminals, Fleet, and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Governed remote work across your own devices, with local policy, Fleet, durable sessions, and real terminals.
interface.longDescription: Light Remote connects ChatGPT and Codex to explicitly authorized user-owned devices. It combines local-first A/B enrollment, device-local final policy, Main/Fleet multi-device governance, durable sessions and recoverable jobs, bounded filesystem/search/process tools, real PTY/ConPTY terminals, activity observability, and signed update/recovery architecture. Targets remain explicit and Light Remote never silently falls back to another device.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Light Remote, show my device topology and effective permissions, and explain what you can safely do before making changes.
Inspect my Light Remote Fleet, open a durable session on the device I choose, investigate the workspace, and show the recent activity trail.
Open a real interactive terminal on my selected device, run the failing test, interrupt it with Ctrl-C if it hangs, and recover the output without repeating the command.
Explain why a privileged operation is denied on my selected device using its effective policy and recent Light Remote activity.
Show my Main device and Fleet state, then switch Main only if I explicitly name another eligible device.
